Add layer mask (Option-click for a black mask)
zh-Hans: 添加图层蒙版（按住 Option 点按可添加黑色蒙版）

zh-Hans: 添加显示选区的图层蒙版（按住 Option 点按则隐藏选区）

key: Adds film grain, strongest in the middle tones.
zh-Hans: 添加胶片颗粒，在中间调最强。

key: Adds green or magenta to the darkest tones.
zh-Hans: 给最暗的色调加入绿色或洋红。

key: Adds or softens contrast along broader shapes.
zh-Hans: 沿较大的形状增加或柔化对比。

key: Adjusts the bright parts of the picture. Hold Option to see clipped highlights.
zh-Hans: 调整画面的高光区域。按住 Option 可查看溢出的高光。

key: Adjusts the dark parts of the picture. Hold Option to see clipped shadows.
zh-Hans: 调整画面的阴影区域。按住 Option 可查看溢出的阴影。

key: Analyze the active layer only, or every visible layer as shown
zh-Hans: 只分析当前图层，或分析所有可见图层的显示效果

key: Animated GIF: select it to show its frames under the canvas
zh-Hans: 动画 GIF：选中后可在画布下方显示各帧

key: Another app changed this project. You can revert to the version on disk, losing your unsaved changes, or keep what you have.
zh-Hans: 另一个应用更改了这个项目。你可以恢复到磁盘上的版本（未存储的更改会丢失），或保留当前内容。

key: Applies generic profile strength when camera metadata is not available.
zh-Hans: 没有相机元数据时，按通用配置文件强度应用。
改为应用到此范围以外

key: Auto balances the average color. Custom follows Temperature and Tint.
zh-Hans: 自动按平均色平衡；自定则跟随色温与色调。

key: Automatically download and install updates in the future
zh-Hans: 以后自动下载并安装更新

key: Bake keeps the current masked appearance in the dependent layers’ pixels. Remove Links reveals their pixels. You can undo either choice.
zh-Hans: 「烘焙」会把当前的蒙版效果写入相关图层的像素；「移除链接」会露出它们的原始像素。两种选择都可以撤销。

key: Basic is quick; Advanced refines the mask against the layer's own detail, for hair and fur
zh-Hans: 基础模式更快；高级模式依据图层自身细节细化蒙版，适合头发和毛发

key: Blend the chosen color into the edges while keeping the center unchanged
zh-Hans: 把所选颜色融入边缘，中心保持不变

key: Blur only the colors, keeping the layer's outline and transparency as they are
zh-Hans: 只模糊颜色，保持图层轮廓与透明度不变

key: Break the lines into beads where the picture is darker than this, blending into solid lines where it's brighter
zh-Hans: 画面暗于此值的部分把线条断成珠点，更亮处则融为实线

key: Brightens or darkens the corners to counter lens falloff.
zh-Hans: 提亮或压暗四角，以抵消镜头暗角。

key: Brightens or darkens the whole picture, in stops of light. Hold Option to see clipped highlights.
zh-Hans: 以曝光级为单位提亮或压暗整个画面。按住 Option 可查看溢出的高光。

key: Brighter than white kept · Transparency kept
zh-Hans: 保留高于白的亮度 · 保留透明

key: Brings back detail in bright areas the camera partly clipped
zh-Hans: 找回相机轻微溢出的亮部细节

key: CMYK writes a printer's inks through the profile in View › CMYK › Profile
zh-Hans: CMYK 按「显示 › CMYK › 配置文件」中的配置输出印刷油墨

key: Chooses how bright an area must be to glow. Has no effect until Glow is raised.
zh-Hans: 选择区域需要多亮才会发光。在提高「发光」之前无效。

key: Chooses how strongly the calibration sliders below are applied. Version 6 is the current default.
zh-Hans: 决定下方校准滑块的应用强度；版本 6 为当前默认值。

key: Clear the haze that leaves background showing through thin areas
zh-Hans: 清除雾感，避免稀薄处透出背景

key: Clears haze when raised, and adds haze when lowered.
zh-Hans: 提高可去雾，降低可加雾。

key: Click a pixel that should be neutral.
zh-Hans: 点按本应为中性灰的像素。

key: Click a purple or green fringe to set its hue range.
zh-Hans: 点按紫色或绿色边缘可设定其色相范围。

key: Click a shortcut, then press its new key combination, or ⊗ to remove it. Changes apply when you save.
zh-Hans: 点按某个快捷键后按下新的组合键，或按 ⊗ 将其移除。存储后生效。

key: Click an object to select its outline · Tab for Wand · Shift add · Option subtract · Drag inside to move · ⌘-drag moves pixels · Delete clears · ⌘D deselect
zh-Hans: 点按对象以选取其轮廓 · Tab 切换到魔棒 · Shift 加选 · Option 减选 · 在框内拖移可移动 · ⌘-拖移移动像素 · Delete 清除 · ⌘D 取消选择

key: Click and drag two points on canvas
zh-Hans: 在画布上点按并拖出两个点

key: Click corners · Click start, double-click or Enter to close · Delete removes corner · Escape cancel
zh-Hans: 点按添加角点 · 点按起点、双击或按 Enter 闭合 · Delete 删除角点 · Escape 取消

key: Click or drag on the canvas to move the center
zh-Hans: 在画布上点按或拖移可移动中心

key: Click or drag to move the view
zh-Hans: 点按或拖移可移动视图

key: Click the fringe on the layer. Click the eyedropper again to stop.
zh-Hans: 点按图层上的彩色边缘取样；再次点按吸管可停止。

key: Click the image to pick the color to select.
zh-Hans: 点按图像可拾取要选择的颜色。

key: Click the original layer to set %@. Click the eyedropper again to stop.
zh-Hans: 点按原始图层可指定 %@；再次点按吸管可停止。

key: Click the original layer. Click the eyedropper again to stop.
zh-Hans: 点按原始图层取样；再次点按吸管可停止。

key: Click the picture to save a color. Up to eight colors.
zh-Hans: 点按画面可记下一个颜色，最多八个。

key: Click to add a point. Drag to adjust.
zh-Hans: 点按可添加控制点，拖移可调整。

key: Click to select similar colors · Tab for Object · Shift add · Option subtract · Drag inside to move · ⌘-drag moves pixels · Delete clears · ⌘D deselect
zh-Hans: 点按以选取相近颜色 · Tab 切换到对象 · Shift 加选 · Option 减选 · 在框内拖移可移动 · ⌘-拖移移动像素 · Delete 清除 · ⌘D 取消选择

key: Click to select; double-click to edit; Option-drag to copy %@
zh-Hans: 点按可选中；双击可编辑；按住 Option 拖移可拷贝%@

key: Click to zoom in · Option-click to zoom out · Drag right or left to zoom smoothly · Space to pan
zh-Hans: 点按放大 · Option-点按缩小 · 向左或向右拖移可平滑缩放 · 空格平移

key: Clipping mask based on %@. Option-click the bottom of its row to release.
zh-Hans: 基于%@的剪贴蒙版。按住 Option 点按其行底部可释放。

key: Clone Stamp (S) · Option-click sets the source
zh-Hans: 仿制图章 (S) · 按住 Option 点按设定源点

key: Color the result while keeping its tones, for a sepia or a cyanotype
zh-Hans: 为结果着色但保留原有明暗，可用于棕褐或蓝晒效果

key: Compositor will convert these Photoshop features. Nothing is applied until you continue.
zh-Hans: Compositor 将转换以下 Photoshop 功能。在你继续之前不会应用任何更改。

key: Controls how strong the sharpening is.
Copies to one side of the picture, or out to both
zh-Hans: 重影只朝画面一侧，或向两侧扩散

key: Copy from the active layer only, or from every visible layer as shown
zh-Hans: 只从当前图层拷贝，或从所有可见图层的显示效果拷贝

key: Create a canvas or import a file.
Crops empty edges after the transform and fits the result back into the frame.
zh-Hans: 变换后裁掉空边，并把结果重新填满画框。

key: Darkens or lightens the edges. The center does not change.
zh-Hans: 压暗或提亮边缘，中心不变。

key: Darker or lighter before the lines are drawn
zh-Hans: 画线前的整体明暗调整

key: Diffusion is soft and wide, Bloom is tighter, and Halation is a red fringe.
zh-Hans: 扩散柔和而宽，泛光更集中，光晕带红色边缘。

key: Dims the picture outside this color's range. It is not kept when you press OK.
zh-Hans: 压暗该颜色范围以外的画面；按下「确定」后不会保留。

key: Drag a color in the picture. Nearby color families move together.
zh-Hans: 在画面上拖移某个颜色，邻近色系会一起移动。

key: Drag a point. Click to add one. Double-click a point to remove it.
zh-Hans: 拖移控制点；点按可添加，双击可删除。

key: Drag a rectangle · Shift add · Option subtract · Shift again mid-drag square · Drag inside to move · ⌘-drag moves pixels · Delete clears · ⌘D deselect
zh-Hans: 拖移绘制矩形 · Shift 加选 · Option 减选 · 拖动中再按 Shift 为正方形 · 在框内拖移可移动 · ⌘-拖移移动像素 · Delete 清除 · ⌘D 取消选择

key: Drag a text box · Click text to edit · Drag box handles to resize · ⌘Return finish · Escape cancel
zh-Hans: 拖移绘制文本框 · 点按文字可编辑 · 拖动框柄可缩放 · ⌘Return 完成 · Escape 取消

key: Drag an ellipse · Shift add · Option subtract · Shift again mid-drag circle · Drag inside to move · Delete clears · ⌘D deselect
zh-Hans: 拖移绘制椭圆 · Shift 加选 · Option 减选 · 拖动中再按 Shift 为正圆 · 在框内拖移可移动 · Delete 清除 · ⌘D 取消选择

key: Drag inside the wheel. Angle sets hue, distance sets saturation.
zh-Hans: 在色轮内拖移：角度决定色相，距离决定饱和度。

key: Drag on the layer to place a guide. Draw at least two lines.
zh-Hans: 在图层上拖移可放置参考线，至少画两条。

key: Drag on the picture to move the curve for the tone under the pointer.
zh-Hans: 在画面上拖移，可移动指针所在色调的曲线。

key: Drag over blemishes to heal · [ ] size · Shift-[ ] hardness · Escape cancel · Space to pan
zh-Hans: 在瑕疵上拖移以修复 · [ ] 大小 · Shift-[ ] 硬度 · Escape 取消 · 空格平移

key: Drag to crop · Enter apply · Escape cancel · Space to pan
zh-Hans: 拖移裁剪 · Enter 应用 · Escape 取消 · 空格平移

key: Drag to draw a shape on a new layer · Shift %@ · Option from center · Shift-U or Tab for the next shape · Escape cancel · Space to pan
zh-Hans: 拖移在当前图层绘制形状 · Shift 约束为 %@ · Option 从中心绘制 · Shift-U 或 Tab 切换下一个形状 · Escape 取消 · 空格平移

key: Drag to draw · Drag ends to adjust · Shift 45° · 1–0 opacity · Enter apply · Escape cancel
zh-Hans: 拖移绘制 · 拖动端点可调整 · Shift 约束 45° · 1–0 不透明度 · Enter 应用 · Escape 取消

key: Drag to erase · [ ] size · Shift-[ ] hardness · 1–0 opacity · Escape cancel · Space to pan
zh-Hans: 拖移擦除 · [ ] 大小 · Shift-[ ] 硬度 · 1–0 不透明度 · Escape 取消 · 空格平移

key: Drag to move · Handles to resize · Circle to rotate · 1–0 layer opacity · Space to pan
zh-Hans: 拖移移动 · 拖动手柄缩放 · 圆形手柄旋转 · 1–0 图层不透明度 · 空格平移

key: Drag to paint · [ ] size · Shift-[ ] hardness · 1–0 opacity · Escape cancel · Space to pan
zh-Hans: 拖移绘制 · [ ] 大小 · Shift-[ ] 硬度 · 1–0 不透明度 · Escape 取消 · 空格平移

key: Drag to pan · Pinch to zoom
zh-Hans: 拖移平移 · 双指缩放

key: Drag to push pixels · [ ] size · Shift-[ ] hardness · 1–0 strength · Space to pan
zh-Hans: 拖移推移像素 · [ ] 大小 · Shift-[ ] 硬度 · 1–0 强度 · 空格平移

key: Drag to select · Drag inside to move · Shift add · Option subtract · Delete clears · ⌥⌫/⌘⌫ fill · ⌘D deselect
zh-Hans: 拖移以选取 · 在框内拖移可移动 · Shift 加选 · Option 减选 · Delete 清除 · ⌥⌫/⌘⌫ 填充 · ⌘D 取消选择

key: Drag to set hue and saturation. Double-click to reset this wheel.
zh-Hans: 拖移可调整色相与饱和度；双击可重置该色轮。

key: Drag to smudge · [ ] size · Shift-[ ] hardness · 1–0 strength · Space to pan
zh-Hans: 拖移涂抹 · [ ] 大小 · Shift-[ ] 硬度 · 1–0 强度 · 空格平移

key: Drag to soften · [ ] size · Shift-[ ] hardness · 1–0 strength · Space to pan
zh-Hans: 拖移柔化 · [ ] 大小 · Shift-[ ] 硬度 · 1–0 强度 · 空格平移

key: Drag up or down to lift or lower those tones. Drag a divider along the bottom to change which tones each region covers.
zh-Hans: 上下拖移可抬升或压低该色调范围。拖移底部的分隔点可改变各区域覆盖的色调。

key: Draw each chunky pixel as a solid square, or as a round dot like a dot-matrix screen
zh-Hans: 把每个粗像素画成实心方块，或画成点阵屏那样的圆点

key: Draw no line where the picture is darker than this, leaving the screen dark
zh-Hans: 画面暗于此值处不画线，屏幕保持黑暗

key: Draw the marks for the light tones on the dark color, like a glowing screen
zh-Hans: 在深色上绘制表示亮部的点，像发光的屏幕

key: Draw two or more lines on the preview that should be level or vertical.
zh-Hans: 在预览上画出两条或更多本应水平或垂直的线。

key: Drop to open in a new canvas
zh-Hans: 拖放到此处可在新画布中打开

key: Each channel from a layer, read as grayscale · PNG
zh-Hans: 把图层的各通道读作灰度 · PNG

key: Emphasizes fine texture over broader edges.
zh-Hans: 强调细小纹理而非较大的边缘。

key: Enabled masks apply here, as on the canvas. Drag or scroll to move around; double-click switches between Fit and 100%.
zh-Hans: 启用的蒙版在此同样生效。拖移或滚动可移动视图；双击可在「适合」与 100% 之间切换。

key: End of the hue range, in degrees.
zh-Hans: 色相范围的终点，单位为度。

key: Enter a positive ratio within the document size limits.
zh-Hans: 请输入一个在文档尺寸限制内的正数比例。

key: Enter a size up to %@ pixels at this DPI.
zh-Hans: 在此 DPI 下最大可输入 %@ 像素。

key: Enter a whole number from 1 to %lld px.
zh-Hans: 请输入 1 到 %lld 像素之间的整数。

key: Enter whole numbers from 1 to %@ pixels.
zh-Hans: 请输入 1 到 %@ 像素之间的整数。

key: Fade the edge of the selection by this many pixels
zh-Hans: 按此像素数柔化选区边缘

key: Fill the selection using surrounding pixels from this layer.
zh-Hans: 用该图层周围的像素填充选区。

key: Final dimensions must be 1–%@ pixels per side.
zh-Hans: 最终尺寸的每边须在 1–%@ 像素之间。

key: Font face, including bold and italic variants
zh-Hans: 字体系列，包含粗体与斜体变体

key: GIF keeps fully transparent or opaque pixels; soft edges use a 50% threshold.
zh-Hans: GIF 只保留完全透明或完全不透明的像素；柔和的边缘按 50% 阈值处理。

key: HDR layer: keeps light brighter than white, shown as white
zh-Hans: HDR 图层：保留高于白色的亮度，显示为白色

key: HSL lists every color. Color edits one family. Point Color adjusts a color you pick.
zh-Hans: HSL 列出所有颜色；颜色只编辑一个色系；点颜色用于调整拾取到的单个颜色。

key: Height in pixels; the width follows, keeping the proportions
zh-Hans: 高度（像素）；宽度按比例跟随

key: Hide the background behind a layer mask, keeping the foreground subjects. The pixels stay, so the background can be painted back at any time.
zh-Hans: 用图层蒙版遮住背景、保留主体。像素不会删除，随时可以再画回来。

key: Highlight Priority protects bright edges. Color Priority also reduces color. Paint Overlay covers the edges evenly.
zh-Hans: 高光优先保护明亮边缘；颜色优先同时降低饱和度；叠加覆盖则均匀压暗边缘。

key: Hold Shift to add or Option to subtract for one outline
zh-Hans: 按住 Shift 加选、按住 Option 减选，只针对一次轮廓

key: How bright a light has to be to flare; near 100, only the biggest, brightest spots
zh-Hans: 产生耀斑所需的亮度；接近 100 时只有最大最亮的光点才会出现

key: How bright a light has to be to sparkle; near 100, only the biggest, brightest spots
zh-Hans: 产生星芒所需的亮度；接近 100 时只有最大最亮的光点才会出现

key: How bright the lines are where the picture is black, so they show even over black
zh-Hans: 画面全黑处线条的亮度，使其在纯黑上仍可见

key: How brightly lights open into discs
zh-Hans: 光源散开成光斑的亮度

key: How far a color may be from the picked ones and still be selected
zh-Hans: 颜色与已拾取颜色的差异在此范围内仍会被选中

key: How far apart the copies are
How far apart the screen's lines are
How far each color channel (0–255) can differ from the clicked color and still be selected
zh-Hans: 各颜色通道 (0–255) 与点按处颜色的差异在此范围内仍会被选中

key: How far from each edge the sharpening reaches, in pixels.
zh-Hans: 锐化从各边缘延伸的距离（像素）。

key: How far in brightness the adjustment reaches.
zh-Hans: 调整在亮度上的作用范围。

key: How far in hue the adjustment reaches.
zh-Hans: 调整在色相上的作用范围。

key: How far in saturation the adjustment reaches.
zh-Hans: 调整在饱和度上的作用范围。

key: How far out of focus: the size of each disc
zh-Hans: 失焦程度：每个光斑的大小

key: How far the blur softens, in pixels
zh-Hans: 模糊柔化的范围，单位为像素

key: How far the brightness is smoothed before it displaces the lines, from sharp ridges to rounded hills
zh-Hans: 亮度在推移线条前的平滑程度：从锐利的脊线到圆缓的丘陵

key: How far the colors spread apart, red one way and blue the other
zh-Hans: 颜色分离的距离，红蓝各朝一侧

key: How far the lens's coatings turn each streak blue along its length; none keeps the light's own color
zh-Hans: 镜头镀膜使光条沿长度方向偏蓝的程度；最低时保持光源本色

key: How far the light wraps around the subject's edges
zh-Hans: 光线环绕主体边缘的范围

key: How far the streaks reach across the picture
How fine the detail it sharpens: small for crisp texture, larger for a punchier look
zh-Hans: 锐化的细节尺度：数值小则质感清晰，数值大则更具冲击力

key: How many spikes each light has, as the lens's aperture blades make them
zh-Hans: 每个光源的星芒数，如同镜头光圈叶片造成的样子

key: How many times the picture echoes, each fainter
zh-Hans: 画面的重影次数，一次比一次淡

key: How much light scatters: a soft halo around bright areas, and gently lifted shadows
zh-Hans: 光线散射的程度：亮部周围出现柔和光晕，暗部被轻轻提亮

key: How much of each pixel's error spreads to its neighbors. Less gives flatter areas
zh-Hans: 每个像素的误差向邻近扩散的比例；越小则色块越平

key: How much of the gap a bright line fills; dimmer parts draw it thinner
zh-Hans: 亮线占据间隙的比例；较暗处画得更细

key: How much of the profile distortion correction is applied.
zh-Hans: 应用配置文件畸变校正的程度。

key: How much of the profile vignetting correction is applied.
zh-Hans: 应用配置文件晕影校正的程度。

key: How strongly edges and fine detail are brought out
zh-Hans: 边缘与细节被强调的强度

key: How the light ends on the inside: low feathers it off softly from the edge, high holds it bright and ends it crisply
zh-Hans: 光在内侧的收束方式：低值从边缘柔和淡出，高值保持明亮并干脆收住

key: How the line's ends, and each of its dashes and dots, are finished
zh-Hans: 线条两端以及每一段虚线和点的收尾方式

key: Hue and saturation of this wheel.
zh-Hans: 该色轮的色相与饱和度。

key: Hue around the wheel, saturation outward from the center. Control-click to show the histogram.
zh-Hans: 色相沿圆周分布，饱和度由中心向外递增。按住 Control 点按可显示直方图。

key: Hue range where green defringe runs.
zh-Hans: 绿色去边作用的色相范围。

key: Hue range where purple defringe runs.
